recipe.visualDefinition: A medium close-up profile of a bearded male singer in a light-colored suit holding a microphone, set against a dark stage background with a diagonal blue light beam. The left side features a vertical stack of high-contrast, multi-colored typography in condensed serif and sans-serif styles.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject occupies the right two-thirds of the frame facing left.
Text is anchored to the left third against a solid dark background.
Diagonal blue light beam creates a dynamic counter-angle to the subject's posture.
Color palette links the subject's pocket square to the primary title text.
coreInvariants: Dark background with a single diagonal light source

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Singer is positioned on the right, scaled to fill the vertical height from waist to head.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The singer's face and microphone form the central focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large pink initial on the left, move down the title stack, then follow the microphone to the singer's face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black negative space on the left serves as a canvas for the primary text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black background provides high contrast for all elements.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Off-white/cream suit and light blue diagonal light provide brightness.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant magenta-pink and golden yellow for primary typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in text elements against a low-value, muted background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-condensed serif and heavy rounded sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast in serif elements
Mixed case usage for visual texture
characterSpecificRedesigns: Oversized initial letter for the primary name
Lowercase 'the' in a contrasting serif style
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for impact paired with clean sans-serif for legibility.

preserve: High contrast between serif and sans-serif

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast, vertically elongated look of the main name.
Provides the necessary weight and density for the secondary title blocks.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photo of a man with a beard in profile, wearing a cream-colored blazer and dark shirt, holding a silver microphone. The background should be solid black on the left and have a diagonal light blue stage light beam on the right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add vertically stacked text on the left side. Use an extra-condensed serif font in yellow and pink for the top section, and a smaller white sans-serif list at the bottom. Ensure the first letter of the top name is significantly larger.

verificationChecks: Is the singer in profile facing left?
Is the text left-aligned in the black area?
Is there a diagonal blue light beam?

adjustableVariables: Specific colors of the display text
mustRedesign: Specific artist names and song titles
Unique facial features of the specific performer

mustAchieve: Clear separation between photo and text area

postGenerationChecks: Text does not overlap the singer's face.
The blue light beam maintains a sharp diagonal edge.
The suit texture is visible but not distracting.
Typography colors are vibrant and distinct.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a profile stage portrait with a dedicated vertical text column on a solid dark field, using ultra-condensed serif fonts for a retro-broadcast aesthetic.
